The '''Seville Family''', also known as the '''Seville pirate clan''', was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] clan that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
The Sevilles were led by [[Darion Seville]] and were based in a compound on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. They were rivals of the [[Vallaido Clan]]. After the Sevilles made an alliance with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they used their combined forces to [[Raid against the Vallaido fleet|devastate]] the Vallaido fleet.<ref name="CRO" />

Darion Seville often got her [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to duel each other. During one such duel, the droid [[MdZ-BLK]] attempted to kill her. Her son, [[Yearo Seville]], stepped in and saved her and afterward sent the droid as a gift to [[Gorbu Dalo]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] pirate who was a rival of the Sevilles, in the hope that the droid would kill Dalo. MdZ-BLK killed the Hutt, but afterward reprogrammed a number of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] and had them turn a captured [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] into a bomb and fly it into the Sevilles' asteroid compound.<ref name="CRO" />
